surface: gh plate bootstrap, gh plate release status, gh plate release target-epic, MCP release tools, .plate release config
summary: Add multi-track release bootstrap branches, richer Next Release / linked-Epic status reporting, and validated target-epic guidance for the refined PLATE release ceremony.
migration_impact: PLATE repositories can now bootstrap release-major/release-minor/release-patch alongside legacy release, read richer release-status signals, and use validated target-epic guidance while the final issue-to-issue GitHub link remains a manual UI step.
migration_guidance: 1. Run `gh plate bootstrap --apply` to create release-major, release-minor, release-patch, and legacy release when they are absent.
2. Use `gh plate release status` or MCP `plate_release_status` to inspect the active Next Release, linked Epics, on-hold Epics, and track summary.

3. Use `gh plate release target-epic <epic-number>` or MCP `plate_release_target_epic` to validate the Epic and identify the active Next Release before completing the final issue-to-issue link in the GitHub UI.
4. If you use `.plate`, optionally add a `release` section for default track policy and downstream trigger configuration.
agent_notes: Do not assume GitHub can create the Epic-to-Release issue link via API. Use the helper output to validate state, then complete the link manually in GitHub UI and re-run release status to confirm the Epic moves out of the on-hold bucket.
